model.score_convention: Ultralytics detector confidence; not a calibrated image-level PASS probability
model.preprocessing: uint8 BGR -> Ultralytics aspect-preserving letterbox imgsz=640; original-pixel xyxy output; no EXIF transform on incoming frames
model.rejection: Only learned non_catalogue detection; complete open-set rejection not validated
model.decision_stage: shared observed-vs-expected count rule; learned ID0 forces FAIL

initialization.source: Official Ultralytics COCO-pretrained YOLO11n; same initialization SHA as historical P06 trainer

model.rejection_validation: PARTIAL: learned class0 only; not arbitrary unknown/incorrect-size rejection
model.count_decision_score: none: decision derived from observed vs expected counts; object scores unchanged
model.offline_timing: perf_counter: adapter preprocess/features/classifier/postprocess/result validation + GPU completion sync; excludes image decoding, weight load and export; not live latency
